items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's your third wife, Helen. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Gene came to see me. Gene was in Los Angeles, and he had heard that I had left the Ory band. I didn't know what he came here for, what the occasion was. They came, they'd been playing, and they were here. And he came and asked did I want the job, and he made me a pretty good offer. And one reason why I took it... The money really wasn't that good; it was adequate. Helen's people...
